subject: ADR-243: a model keeps the numbers it was given -- the ecology lab's theory bench keeps what each model was typed and says whose numbers it is drawn from, and the two-site verdict says which figure it is reading
body: The tenth blind trial filed two defects on the ecology lab. Choosing a theory model rebuilt its parameter boxes from the defaults, so the numbers a model had been given were gone after a look at another model and the .eco line built next was a protocol nobody typed; now each model keeps what it was given, puts it back when chosen again, and the line under the boxes says which numbers it is drawn from. The two-site verdict read Bray-Curtis alone and called sites sharing 3 of 7 kinds nearly identical; now, where the counts agree and the membership does not, it names both figures and places the turnover among the scarce kinds, and identical sites are called identical. Task 345 to 359, refuted on the old page; verify_eco 200 to 227 against a port of the word and the model; new mutate_ecolab runner, 12 killed.
